title: Izwi Eliyiqiniso Lasezikhathini Zasendulo
intro: Kukhona umphefumulo e-Quran onendaba elandiswa ngamavesi ambalwa nje, kodwa izimfanelo zawo ezinhle zikhanya ngokucacile okukhulu. Idunyiswa nguSomandla ngenxa yobuhle obukhethekile, le nceku yasendulo yoMuntu Onomusa inendawo emakhasini esambulo. Umsebenzi wakho ukuhlonza lo muntu ophawulekayo. Ungaqagela ukuthi bangobani?
clues: Ngingumprofethi ka-Allah owayephila phakathi kwezizukulwane zokuqala zesintu.
U-Allah ungikhulumele eNcwadini Yakhe kanye nabanye abaprofethi, bonke bedunyiswa ngenxa yobuhle obufanayo obuhle.
U-Allah wangiphakamisela endaweni ephakeme abanye abambalwa abayifinyelele.
Igama lami lishiwo kuSurah Al-Anbiya, lihlanganiswe nabanye abaprofethi ababili abadunyiswa ngokubekezela kwabo.
